messages:
maria: Heads-up — after the SDK compatibility shim landed were seeing duplicated route telemetry in the console. split counts across headers. :confused:
ajay: I noticed the spike in the ingestion metrics. Some requests show both the legacy and new headers.
maria: Example from the proxy logs: 
```
{"time":"2026-03-20T09:12:34Z","headers":{"X-Redwood-Route":"tenant-42/priorityA","X-Rdw-RouteHint":"priorityA"}}
```
That turns into two route attributions downstream.
kelly: Is the double-emission happening on the client (SDK) or at the ingestion layer?
ajay: The SDK shim intentionally sets X-Rdw-RouteHint and preserves X-Redwood-Route for backcompat. Ingestion dedup keyed on header name, so both get recorded separately.
sam: Quick win: normalize headers in ingestion to a canonical route before emitting metrics. Prefer new header when present. I can push a small hotfix.
kelly: Do that but warn SDK owners and billing. This could affect dashboard alerts and short-term usage counts.
ajay: Proposed immediate action items:
- hotfix: coalesce headers (prefer X-Rdw-RouteHint) in ingestion
- backfill: reconcile last 48h counts once raw export is ready
- SDK: add opt-in env var REDWOOD_SHIM_STRICT=false for slow migration
maria: ops-bot, can you queue a raw export for 2026-03-19 00:00 UTC -> 2026-03-21 00:00 UTC?
ops-bot: export job eps-20260321-01 queued, ETA ~45m.
sam: ingest pseudo-fix: 
```
// lowercase names, prefer new header
const hdr = headers['x-rdw-routehint'] || headers['x-redwood-route'];
if (hdr) emitMetric('route.request', {route: hdr});
```
This prevents double-counting.
kelly: Also add a dashboard tile "header-split ratio" = requests_with_both / requests_with_any; alert if > 5%.
ajay: SDK follow-up: emit a single request body field route_canonical in addition to headers so proxies can't split us. I'll open a tiny PR.
maria: Steps recap: 1) sam deploy hotfix (canary eu-west-1) 2) ops run export + handoff 3) ajay add env flag + changelog note 4) devex add tile + alert. I'll post status to #product and #support once canary is green.
sam: rolling canary now. will post deploy id.
(10m)
sam: canary merged, no anomalies in 10m. :thumbsup:
ajay: PR opened: add REDWOOD_SHIM_STRICT and docs. Also note: some proxies changed header casing causing duplicates (x-rdw-routehint vs X-Rdw-RouteHint). Ingestion hotfix will lowercase keys.
sam: included case-normalization in patch.
maria: Thanks. When ops backfill completes coordinate reconciled numbers with billing for affected customers. I'll draft an internal note for support.
kelly: Also flag to SDK owners to avoid removing legacy header until >= 2 weeks after backfill.
maria: Agreed. I'll follow up in ~2h with numbers and a short support blurb. Thanks everyone.
